channel.name: shop-wilhelms-wearable-wonders👗🔮
channel.topic: This shop is run by Seelie fey during the day and Unseelie fey from dusk to dawn. Wilhelm is rarely seen but often can be heard cackling to himself in his shop in the back. Items can be purchased for gold value or a deal can be struck.

content:
**DAYTIME ITEMS AVAILABLE:
**
**Penney’s Peerless Power Polishes**-Wondrous item (consumable) 800g
A brand of black market nail polish often used to smuggle magic into places where it aught not belong. Mixed with a dash of powdered lead to block magic detection from spells and abilities that would do so. You can only cast these spells once per application and only one color may be applied at a time. Each bottle has 5 applications.Currently on the market there are only six colors each with their own effect:

      *Revolutionary Red*: Your fierce passion for the cause explodes out with this polish. You can cast  Fireball(3rd level, DC 14).
      *Ben’s Brilliant Blue*: Be as smart, striking, and fashionable as the big brain himself, Benjamin Franklin. Strike a pose and you can cast Lightning 
           Bolt(3rd level, DC14).
     *Proletarian Pink*: Penney’s personal polish, practical, pure, and a protector of proletarian. Stand before you fellows and lead them to rise up. You can  cast Motivational Speech(3rd level).

**Ka-zoom** Bardic instrument (requires attunement by a bard) 2,000g
This magical kazoo add +1 to your Spell Attack bonus and spell save DC while attuned to it.
As a bonus action you can blow into the Ka-zoom to cast Haste on yourself. The effect persists for a number of rounds equal to your Con modifier (minimum of 1)

**Lyre's Chord** Bardic instrument (requires attunement by a bard) 2,000
Carved from Fae'd Oak and strung with Strands of Ley, any who hear the melodies plucked have their confidence in themselves bolstered. Whenever someone uses your bardic inspiration they can roll the die twice and take the higher of the two.

**Crown of Cael'fii Rare**, Wondrous item (requires attunement by spellcaster) 4,500g 
A crown woven from twigs pulled from the branches of Cael'fii. Once attuned to the crown you can now cast the Shillelagh cantrip, if you don’t already know it. While attuned the cantrip is modified in the following ways: -you may use this cantrip on any weapon made of wood. -as an action, you may make a special attack that releases the magical powers imbued into the weapon. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the weapon deals an extra 1d8 damage (2d8) and the spell ends.

**Gauntlet of the Seasons Wondrous Item** (requires attunement) 4,000g
This gauntlet appears to be carved from white oak. A pink Opal, red Jasper, orange Carnelian, and Lapis Lazuli are inlaid across the top of knuckles. Unarmed Strikes get +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. These gauntlets have 5 charges, which are refreshed at dawn each morning. As a part of an attack action you may spend a charge to add the power of one of the seasons to your attack. The target takes an additional 2d4 damage. Choose one of the d4s. The number rolled on that die determines the additional damage type, as shown below. d4 | Damage Type 1 | Radiant 2 | Fire 3 | Necromantic 4 | Cold If you roll the same number on both d4s, the power of the season leaps from the target to a different creature of your choice within 10 feet of it. Make an attack roll against the new target, and roll a new 2d4 damage roll, which could cause the power of the seasons to leap again. A creature can be targeted only once by each use of the gauntlet.

**Prosthetic Limb** Wondrous item, common 100g
This item replaces a lost limb a hand, an arm, a foot, a leg, or a similar body part. While the prosthetic is attached, it functions identically to the part it replaces. You can detach or reattach it as an action, and it can't be removed against your will. It detaches if you die. Limbs grown from this shop apear as branches  on their hosts.

**Dr. Wynn’s Herbalist Bag **Wondrous item 1,000g
A leather bag, made from different animal hides and stitched together with plant fibers, the interior has numerous pockets, each with an embroidered plant on the side. This bag counts as an herbalist’s kit and gives the wielder advantage on checks to find and identify herbs. This bag also contains 10 charges, using the herbs you may spend up to three charges as a bonus action to heal someone 1d6 hit points per charge. The charges refresh if you spend at least an hour searching for herbs or spend at least 50gp on resupplying the bag.

**NIGHTTIME ITEMS AVAILABLE:**

**Penney’s Peerless Power Polishes**-Wondrous item (consumable) 600g
A brand of black market nail polish often used to smuggle magic into places where it aught not belong. Mixed with a dash of powdered lead to block magic detection from spells and abilities that would do so. You can only cast these spells once per application and only one color may be applied at a time. Each bottle has 5 applications.Currently on the market there are only six colors each with their own effect:

     *Cat’s Paw Purple:* Display how safe and innocent you are with a simple flourish of your hand, before striking your foe. You can cast Hypnotic 
          Pattern(3rd level, DC14).
     *Bear-garden Black:* Interrupt those that would try to cast down on you with a raucous interjection. You can cast Counterspell(3rd level, only affects 
          spells of 3rd level or lower).
     *Gillygaupus Green*: Some consider this green to be a bit silly, prove them wrong and show them they are true Gillyguapus. You can cast Bestow 
            Curse(3rd level, DC14, no concentration).

**Wilhelm’s Folly Rare**, quarterstaff (requires attunement) 2,000g
Requires at least 16 Charisma
A staff designed for a mad comic who wished to “...really blow the audience away.” Atop the head of the staff is an enchanted metal cage that amplifies it’s users voice three fold. This staff has 7 charges. While attuned to it you may use the charges in the following ways.
 Spend 3 charges to cast a 3rd level Pulse Wave spell (push only, save DC 15)
Spend 2 charges for the staff to act as a 3rd level Spiritual Weapon spell. When being used in this way you can’t use the staff for anything else until the spell ends.
Spend 3 charges to cast Hideous Laughter spell (save DC 15) on up to 3 targets within 30ft of each other.
This staff regains 1d6+1 charges daily at dawn.

**Mask of the Unassuming** Wondrous item (requires attunement by a spellcaster) 3,000g
A half mask that covers the lower half of the wearer’s face. It can appear to be the lower half of a face or simple face covering. While wearing this mask and attuned to it, you can ignore the vocal component of any spells you cast and Counterspells have disadvantage against your spells. You also have a +5 on Dexterity(Stealth) and Charisma(Deception) checks when trying to blend in with a crowd.

**Moon Thistle Bonsai** (Requires attunement by a druid or ranger) 250g
A small potted tree that's branches can be harvested daily to make 1d6 magical wooden ammunition for a Bow or Crossbow. It regrows every night as long as it bathes in moonlight. You can trim up to 1d6 wooden magical ammo that lasts up to 24 hours before losing their potency.

**Darling's Duster** Wondrous Item (requires attunement) 1,500g
A maroon duster with mustard yellow silk lining covered in a paisley pattern of teal and aqua. The coat has four large pockets on the interior of the coat, each is large enough for a standard book. Stitched into one of the pockets is the word "Bookworm." As the coattails flow near the floor wisps of smoke or mist (your choice) pour from beneath. While you are attuned to this item you can cast Fog Cloud at will, (1st level version, centered on yourself). Once per day you may cast gaseous form on yourself, this ability recharges at dawn.

**Feywild Shard** Wondrous item uncommon (requires attunement by a sorcerer) 750g
This warm crystal glints with the sunset colors of the Feywild sky and evokes whispers of emotional memory. As an action, you can attach the shard to a Tiny object (such as a weapon or a piece of jewelry) or detach it. It falls off if your attunement to it ends. You can use the shard as a spellcasting focus while you hold or wear it.
When you use a Metamagic option on a spell while you are holding or wearing the shard, you can roll on the Wild Magic Surge table in the Player's Handbook. If the result is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic, and if it normally requires concentration, it doesn't require concentration in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.
If you don't have the Wild Magic Sorcerous Origin, once this property is used to roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

**Twig of Power**, Staff or Wand depending on size 5,000g (requires attunement)
For medium or larger creatures it is treated as a wand and for creatures size small or smaller this item is treated as a quarterstaff that grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +1 to Armor Class, +1 to spell attack rolls, and your spell save DC.
The Twig has 10 charges for the following properties. The staff regains 1d8+2 charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the Twig loses all properties and crumbles to dust. On a 20, the Twig regains 1d4+1 charges.

*Power Strike*. When a small creature hits with a melee attack using the Twig, you can expend a charge to deal 1d4 force damage to the target.

*Magic Dart*. As a staff or wand you can expend a charge to shoot a sliver of magic at a target for 3 force damage. (works similar to Magic Missile)

*Spells*. While wielding this staff or wand, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of it’s charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack bonus: Snowball Swarm (2 charges), Chromatic Orb (2nd level version, fire damage, 2 charges), Shield of Faith (No concentration, 3 charges), Hold Person (2 charges), Levitate (1 charges), Lightning Bolt (3 charges), Ray of Enfeeblement (1 charge), Shield (1 charge)

*Retributive Strike.* You can use an action to break the Twig over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The Twig is destroyed and releases its remaining magic, an explosion that expands to fill a 20 foot radius sphere centered on it.
You have a 50 percent chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 8 * the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown below. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

Distance from Origin        Effect
Less than 10ft away         4 * the number of charges
10 to 15ft away                  3 * the number of charges
16 to 20ft away                 2 * the number of charges
Thomas enters the shop looking for the shopkeeper
<@&851449329872142376> (looking to sell common fiendish Essence for silver)
Thomas seeing no one leaves and heads to <#852738741537865769>
Thomas arrives again trying to find a shopkeeper
A very short boney man in oversized robes and a pointed cap stands behind the counter. He looks up from his worktable at you through thick round glasses.
"Hello there sthranger!"
"Hello there. I was wondering if you would be interested in buying this for some silver pieces?" Thomas holds up a Fiendish Essence (common)
"That'll get you quite the amount of thilver, good man!"
"Howth 500 thilver thound to you?!"
"Sounds like you have a deal. Thank you."
(Don't know why but when I read the description of gauntlet of four seasons I immediately thought of...)
Thomasbids farewell and heads back to <#852738741537865769>
"Thankth for the buthineth!" And he continues working on his project, cackling to himself from time to time.
Evelyn enters, arm-in-arm with Fuddles, with Nolan following behind.
"OK. First what do you like to wear and feel most comfortable in." (She is asking both)
"I haven't worn anything but these clothes since I was a kid."
"I liked to wear dresses."
"Ok. What colors do you like or do you want to try something else?"
"I'll let you decide what you think would work best."
"Well I want you to be comfortable and like what you are wearing. "
"I'll like anything you choose for me."
“I… do not know. What I like.”
“… I have… al-ways wan-ted… to try a dress…” he says this very quietly
"What colors do you like Nolan. I'm sure we can find a dress here to your liking. "
(Ok irl I don't know much about your characters. What are they like. And what colors do they stick to normally. )
(Evelyn usually wears brown, but thats only because its the only clothes she has. she's fine with any color)
(she also has never worn shoes, and she is willing to try)
(She is kinda whimsical right?)
(From the fae?)
(yeah)
(Ok)
“I like… pink… yell-ow… and blue…”
"Ok you two sit over there and give me a few mins."
"Do you think you could help me wash my hair after this?"

She peeks out from behind a shelf
 "Of course!!"

"Ok first Evelyn." Fuddles hands her a few things
"Try these on. If you don't like an we can narrow down your likes some more "
Evelyn will go try them on.
"I think I'd like something... brighter?"
"Ok let me look."
"Did you like any better then the other? Maybe you would like one in a different color."
"I think I'd like something simpler, and brighter. Maybe something pink?"
"Ok let me see what I can find."

What about something like these. She hands her 2 styles. 
"You can take thing away you don't like"
"I like the second one."
She trys it on.
"What do you think?"
"I love it! But I might be bias with the pink. But I think the outfit would fit you in any color. It's very sweet. I think Fin will love it."
<@651981368175230976> In your mind you see an emotionless white mask watching you. It is tied to you by red string.
"Nolan now let's find you something. "
"Oh no..."
She looks at the spot on her hand that she drew blood from.
"Whats wrong. Do you not like it? I can find something else."
"No, its not that."
"I just feel like I made a terrible decision a few days ago."
"In the Noir."
“Where…?” Nolan looks up. “A bor-ough?”
"What do you mean? What decision?"
"We were looking for the lost artifacts of the Clutter family."
"There was this... woman in the Noir..."
"She ran a shop, called the Black Hut."
"She had one of the artifacts, and she wanted a bit of our blood in return."
Fuddles is intently listening
"I gave a drop of my blood... and just now I saw a white mask, with a red string attached to me.."
"Ooh no. Who else was with you?"
"I don't remember all of them."
"I think, Bo, Seraxa, Mictlan, and someone else who's name I can't seem to remember."
"There were others, too."
"Hmm. We should finish up here and go find them and see if they have seen what you just saw."
"I'm not sure where they are."
She turns to Nolan " What do you think about this?"
"Don't worry we will find them."
Evelyn will pay for her dress and say "I'm going to check around town.
